name: Green Pin Dee Shackle BN
desc: Green Pin® dee (D) shackle with safety bolt, nut and split cotter pin — for permanent or long-term installations where the pin must not rotate. Bow and pin forged in high-tensile steel, grade 6, quenched and tempered, with a minimum breaking load of 6× the working load limit. Hot-dipped galvanized, rated −40°C to +200°C. Made to ISO 2415, EN 13889 and ASME B30.26, meeting US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271 Type IVB Class 3; DNV 2.7-1 offshore certification available from 2 t.
